component.name: Murmur
component.summary: A light client for the Murmur network

description.p: Read and write threads and replies on the Murmur network, keep a wallet and send transfers. Murmur checks every block header itself, and proves everything it shows against them, so the node it reads from can't make anything up.

ul.li: Threads, replies, answers and mentions, with notifications
A wallet whose key never leaves the device, kept in the system's keyring
Public names and pictures, invitations for newcomers
A Murmur node of its own, run beside the app, which can mine

description.p: It runs on the public testnet, whose tokens are for testing only.
